class.name: SlangShaderProgram
class.description: A single compiled program within a [SlangShaderFile]. Contains both the compiled SPIR-V and reflection metadata related to this particular program within a shader. A compute program is built from one entry-point and appears in [member SlangShaderFile.kernels]; a raster program is built from a vertex and a fragment entry-point linked together and appears in [member SlangShaderFile.passes].

method.name: get_compile_error
method.description: Returns the compile error reported for any stage of this program, or an empty string if it compiled successfully.

members.member: The name of this kernel. By default, this will match the entry-point function name declared in the shader.

Get the reflection information of the parameters for this kernel. You typically won't need to access this, but it is used under the hood by [SlangShaderTask] to bind data to the correct descriptor slots.
The slot offset of this kernel's parameters, relative to the global parameters.
The space offset of this kernel's parameters, relative to the global parameters.
The SPIR-V intermediate representation of this program, with one bytecode entry per shader stage it provides.
The shader stages this program provides, as a bitmask of [code]RenderingDevice.SHADER_STAGE_*_BIT[/code] values.
The thread group size declared for this kernel.
The binding sets that are used by this kernel. The key is the binding set index, and the value is true/false.
Reflection information about any declared attributes on the entry-point function.
